notes: Native conditional-Gaussian/Bingham point density is evaluated exactly at each queried modal pose; it is not raw pixel likelihood or success probability.

Expected-likelihood comparison is the existing native-image Gaussian-chart proxy overlapped with a freshly requeried O(P) pose/direction Gaussian, transformed to one fixed Keep-prior observation chart. It is not an exact nonlinear candidate integral.
The same native image modes, weights/log weights, coupling/covariance and normalizers are retained for all comparisons.
The native board regeneration is checked against the originally saved central distribution before any comparison.
No candidate is discarded, smoothed, reweighted or relinearized in production.
